messages.content: Suppose a sequence of polynomials B_n(x) converge pointwise to f(x) on [0, 1]. Does it follow that the B_n converge uniformly? Ensure that stop words constitute no more than 20% of the total words in your response.

message.content: No. Pointwise convergence does not imply uniform convergence. Consider $B_n(x) = x^n$ on [0,1]. Limit is 0 for $x<1$, 1 at $x=1$. Discontinuity prevents uniformity. Weierstrass theorem requires continuity of limit function. Here limit discontinuous. Thus failure occurs. Counterexample suffices.
